title: The Batman
description: The Batman universe mod. That add armor and items.
body:
# The Batman

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.6-green) ![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-blue) ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-In_Development-orange)

**The Batman** is a Minecraft mod project that aims to faithfully recreate the universe of the *The Batman* movie.

## Current Features

### Armor
* **The Batman Suit** (Bruce Wayne)

### Item
* **Grappling Hook :**
    * Type right click to lock a block to climb or a entity to grab.
* **Batarang :**
    * Throw it with your right click to damage a entity.

---

## Installation

1.  Install 1.20.6 version of the **Fabric Loader**.
2. Download the **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.100.8+1.20.6)** mod and place it in your `mods` folder.
3. Download **The Batman** `.jar` file and place it in your `mods` folder.
4. Launch the game and run !

---
